name: Caddos Birdes
body:
Caddos Birdes
CR 1/4

This miniature horse has a coat of dappled shades of green and a frond-like tail of mossy green hair.

XP 100
N Small animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +1 size)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 hooves -5 (1d3)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 13, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 7
Base Atk +0; CMB -1; CMD 10
Feats RunB, Stealthy
Skills Escape Artist +3, Perception +5, Stealth +7 (+15 in vegetation)
SQ docile

ECOLOGY

Environment any forests
Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3-18)
Treasure incidental

These tiny horses dwell in forests and scrub brush hills, with their unusual variegated green coats making them hard to spot by predators. Some claim that caddos birdes are magical fey creatures, but despite their appearance they are entirely natural. Some tiny fey have been known to train and ride them, though on their own they are relatively docile and skittish. A caddos birdes is around 2-3 feet high at the shoulder.
